sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
There is a warrior named Hanbei the Undying, or also Hanbei the Infested, who can be found just outside the Dilapidated Temple.
"A warm body that can't die might prove useful to you. I volunteer mine."
If you're looking for someone to train with, he may be an ideal opponent.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Hanbei, the Undying (死なず半兵衛) is one of the only inhabitants of the Dilapidated Temple, beside the Sculptor. He's a veteran samurai who became an "Infested" (蟲憑, bug-haunted), a being who cannot perish through normal means. This man of few words will stoically offer to become Wolf's sparring partner to train him.
He'll also suggest Sekiro to check the Offering Box from time to time, as it may hold some interesting treasure.
After acquiring the Mortal Blade, Hanbei will ask Wolf to finally put an end to his life. Should Wolf agree to follow through, Hanbei will later be found kneeled down and ready to embrace death. He'll leave behind a Hidden Tooth.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying
sections.text:
In this manga series, it's revealed that Hanbei was one of General Tamura's soldiers and that he became immortal when, after being killed by Isshin Ashina, a monk dropped a centipede on his body.
Now undying, he wanders the land aimlessly, until one day Shoukichi, a young man who thought Hanbei was a bandit on his way to raid his village, attacks him. However the man's sister, Suzu, moved by pity for the disgraced warrior, takes him into their house. Once awaken again, Hanbei repays the favor by repelling a group of Ashina Soldiers, who were about to kill Shoukichi.
Some day later, he asks Hanbei for help again: he and other men are about to head off to patrol the woods, as lately people who ventured into the forest have gone missing. Villagers thought it was the work of bandits, but a trail of corpses leads them to a shocking discovery: a hermit has been driven mad by his red eyes and has been cannibalizing anyone who entered the woods. As the fight with Hanbei drags on, the Guardian Ape is drawn to the deranged man and ultimately ends up devouring him.
It's revealed that this red-eyed man was an experiment of Doujun, who then sent the Ashina Soldiers to keep an eye on him. The father of one of those soldiers wants to take revenge on Hanbei and kidnaps Suzu to lure him into Ashina Castle, where he and his son, who healed his wounds with Doujun's rejuvenating waters, will wait to ambush him. Hanbei comes off victorious from the battle, but, seen as the young woman lost her mind trapped in the Abandoned Dungeon, decides to finish her off. Having now lost everything once again and with a sin to expiate, Hanbei heads for the Dilapidated Temple with the hope that one day his curse will prove of use to someone.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Dilapidated Temple: at the end of the path to the right from the Sculptor's Idol, next to the Offering Box.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Dilapidated Temple )
sections.text:
Talk to Hanbei and face him in battle. After killing him, he'll get back on his feet.
Speak to him again and accept his request to spar with him.
Hanbei's role is to introduce both the basic and advanced
of the game and to offer a target to practice them on. Since he is immortal, no Deathblow can kill him. During training, Wolf too won't take any Vitality damage.
Hanbei offers training matches and free combat modes to try out newly learned techniques. A training session can be left at any moment by interacting with the fogwall that seals off the battlefield. "Training: Fundamentals" is always available from the start.

sections.heading: Training: Fundamentals
sections.text:
- Attacks: attack Hanbei to fill his Posture bar.
- Deflect: parry Hanbei's attacks to fill his Posture bar.
- Step Dodge: avoid Hanbei's attacks and counter-attack.
Complete all these trainings to unlock "Free Combat (Fundamentals)".
- Mikiri Counter (once the Combat Art is unlocked): dash toward Hanbei's thrust attacks to perform a Mikiri Counter.
- Vault Over (once the Combat Art is unlocked): break Hanbei's Posture and jump on him to perform a Vault Over.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Gate Path )
sections.text: Defeating General Naomori Kawarada just past the Sculptor's Idol is a necessary step to unlock "Training: Applied" at Hanbei.

sections.heading: Training: Applied
sections.text:
- Consecutive Deflections: parry Hanbei's flurry of attacks.
- Vitality and Posture: reduce Hanbei's Vitality to fill up his Posture bar more easily.
- Countering Thrust Attacks: deflect and Step Dodge Hanbei's thrust attacks.
- Countering Sweep Attacks: jump-kick Hanbei's sweep attacks to damage his Posture.
Complete these trainings to unlock "Free Combat (Applied)".

sections.heading: Ashina Castle ( Upper Tower - Ashina Dojo )
sections.text: Grapple your way atop of Ashina Castle to face Genichiro for the second time.

sections.heading: Ashina Castle ( Upper Tower - Kuro's Room )
sections.text: Exhaust Kuro's dialogue, until he reveals Isshin's whereabouts. Traverse the rooftops following the trail of pink smoke signals to reach his room. Question him about the Mortal Blade and its location.

sections.heading: Senpou Temple ( Main Hall )
sections.text: The Illusive Hall Bell has now appeared in the Main Hall of Senpou Temple: ringing it will grant access to the Folding Screen Monkeys bossfight.

sections.heading: Senpou Temple ( Inner Sanctum )
sections.text: Talk to the Divine Child of Rejuvenation to receive the Mortal Blade.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Dilapidated Temple )
sections.text:
After accepting to train with Hanbei, speak to him again to tell him of the Mortal Blade. He'll ask Wolf to sever his ties with immortality.
Once accepted to end Hanbei's undeath, reload the area and talk to him one last time. Perform a Deathblow to remove the centipede from his body. Hanbei will drop a Hidden Tooth.
